svg.title: Marketplace — C4 Container Diagram
svg.desc: Implemented Gateway, Recommendation and Catalog skeletons; planned User, Order, Payment and Notification services, six private PostgreSQL databases, clients and RabbitMQ order-status queue. Gateway calls Order directly. Each database has one owning service.
svg.text: Target architecture and implemented service skeletons · business logic is not implemented
Blue solid frame = implemented skeleton. Dashed frames = planned components, including ALL data stores and the queue.
Client transport is labelled separately; browser access needs a planned gRPC-Web/HTTP adapter. Line crossings are not connections.
